collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A grandparent tells the same funny story for the hundredth time.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a grandparent, tells the same funny story for the hundredth time. A grandchild says the ending along with them, word for word.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a grandparent, tells the same funny story for the hundredth time. This time, the story has a new detail nobody has heard before.
